subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should Cloudflare AI Gateway onboarding add first-class Workers AI endpoint/model selection, fold this acceptance criterion into the broader Cloudflare bridge work, or document the generic custom-provider flow as the supported Workers AI path?
rationale: Source evidence proves the gap, but the fix changes onboarding flags, generated provider config, model defaults, endpoint family, and credential/header semantics, so maintainers need to choose the supported product contract before implementation.

options.title: Add Workers AI Onboarding Mode
options.body: Add plugin-owned non-interactive flags or an endpoint mode that writes an OpenAI-compatible Workers AI provider with selected @cf/... models while preserving the existing Anthropic Gateway path.

options.title: Fold Into Cloudflare Bridge
options.body: Keep this issue open as an acceptance criterion for the broader Cloudflare AI Gateway REST/catalog bridge before implementing a narrower onboarding-only path.

options.title: Document Custom Provider Path
options.body: Declare the generic custom-provider workflow as the supported Workers AI setup and document the exact non-interactive command/config before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Add Workers AI Onboarding Mode
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned non-interactive flags or an endpoint mode that writes an OpenAI-compatible Workers AI provider with selected @cf/... models while preserving the existing Anthropic Gateway path.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature introduction and extension-boundary refactor history make steipete the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
